_comment: External dependency: the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent release the extension is tested against. This pins NOTHING at runtime — the extension loads whatever the user has installed globally (see src/sdk-service.ts), and the devcontainer takes @latest. Its only job is to give scripts/check-currency.mjs something to compare npm's latest against, because on a CI runner no global install exists and drift here was therefore invisible. Bump `testedAgainst` only when you have actually run the extension against that version. 1.5.2 was live-verified headlessly on 2026-11-11 through the real PiService and SdkService under the vscode stub: init, a turn with one tool call, a second turn, one manual compaction, persist, reopen and replay, then two vscode_* bridge tools called by the model in the RESUMED session; /reload refused while streaming (#9222) and succeeded when idle; a /tools-narrowed set restored on reopen (but that reopen lost the model's history: a pre-existing parentless-entry bug, see the findings page); every event type that fired was handled (bash_execution_update never fires: we don't call executeBash). Not live-run on 1.5.2: thinking deltas (thinking was off) and export, both run on 1.3.0; an extension's boundary-draft entries have never been live-run. See agent-wiki/operations/pi-1.5.2-findings.md.
